headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential vulnerabilities and compatibility issues early in the development process. Leverage machine learning models for predictive risk assessment of npm/PyPI packages, including their binding.gyp command expansions.
actions: Implement a real-time vulnerability scanner that checks dependencies against known security advisories and exploits before installation.
